comment_en: Yesterday went 37-25, down 540 yen at 1,000 yen per bet. 📉 Cumulative record stands at 985 picks with a 56.0% win rate and -1.9% return on stakes. A notable highlight was the Arizona vs LAD run line hit at +1,050 yen 💰, while missed totals—such as the Nagasaki under 2.5—stood out as a recurring weak spot.
